notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the skill has no other files). It tells the agent how to generate AGENTS.md context files (build/test commands, structure, code style, boundaries) for a repository's root and pertinent subfolders, plus a fixed one-line CLAUDE.md redirect, only where those files are missing.

Medium because the agent writes persistent agent-instruction files (AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md) into potentially many folders of the user's repository, and future coding agents auto-load them. Acceptable because it is the user-requested deliverable, every write is guarded by an existence check with an explicit never-overwrite rule (SKILL.md:23-38, 188-194, 354), content must be grounded in real repo files with no secrets (SKILL.md:228-234, 373), and the only command run is a read-only `ls ... 2>/dev/null`.

The `<!-- Generated ... Do not edit directly. -->` HTML comment (SKILL.md:347) is visible text inside the generated CLAUDE.md template, not a hidden instruction to the agent. The wiki/ section assumes output from the companion deep-wiki skills, but that is optional and the generator works on any repository.
